body.intent: Prune persistent index databases of worktrees that no longer exist: ~/.cache/rhiza/index held 1580 dbs (14G), mostly from test and run worktrees long gone, and nothing removes them. Found while planning 01M73T319T5VT2Q37MFXTDP8T6 (stale newer-format index entries); the arbiter ruled pruning out of that change set (Decision index-rebuilds-on-entry-format-change).
body.title: Prune orphan index databases
